items.headline: $DRIFT Opens Exploit Recovery Claims, Pays Just 1%
items.summary: $DRIFT begins processing exploit recovery claims, but initial payouts cover only about 1% of user losses. Frustration mounts among affected Solana DeFi users.

items.headline: $NIGHT Privacy Model Draws Zcash Comparisons, ADA Eyes
items.summary: Midnight's $NIGHT privacy model is being compared with Zcash and is attracting attention from Cardano holders as privacy coins heat up.

items.headline: $SOPH Kills zkSync Chain, Rebuilds on Base
items.summary: After raising $60M via node sales but drawing under 200 daily users, Sophon is shutting its zkSync chain and pivoting to consumer apps on Base. $SOPH holders face a major reset.

items.headline: $CC Tops Fee Rankings With $60M in 30 Days
items.summary: Canton Network generated $60.2M in 30-day fees, far ahead of Tron and Ethereum per DefiLlama, putting $CC on the institutional-chain map.

items.headline: Circle Adds Native USDC & CCTP to Plasma ($XPL)
items.summary: Plasma developers get Circle-issued dollar and euro tokens plus a burn-and-mint route for cross-chain USDC transfers, a boost for the $XPL ecosystem.
